description: This file defines a Config class extending BaseConfig, providing configuration methods for a documentation HTML format, including URL preparation, analytics, navigation, and theme settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration class for HTML format in a documentation system, extending BaseConfig and providing various configuration retrieval methods.

methods.name: prepareGithubUrl
methods.description: Prepares a GitHub URL by ensuring HTTPS and correct basepath.

methods.name: getEditOn
methods.description: Returns the URL configuration for editing, based on 'edit_on' or 'edit_on_github' values.

methods.name: showDateModified
methods.description: Checks if date modified should be shown.

methods.name: showPreviousNextLinks
methods.description: Checks if previous/next navigation links should be shown.

methods.name: showCodeToggle
methods.description: Checks if code toggle feature is enabled.

methods.name: hasAutomaticTableOfContents
methods.description: Checks if automatic table of contents is enabled.

methods.name: hasGoogleAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Google Analytics is configured.

methods.name: hasPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Checks if Plausible Analytics domain is set.

methods.name: hasPiwikAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Piwik Analytics is configured.

methods.name: hasPoweredBy
methods.description: Checks if 'powered by' info is set.

methods.name: hasTwitterHandles
methods.description: Checks if Twitter handles are set.

methods.name: hasRepository
methods.description: Checks if repository info is set.

methods.name: hasLandingPage
methods.description: Checks if landing page is enabled.

methods.name: hasThemeVariant
methods.description: Checks if theme variant is set.
